description: Control for cov_c_strict_or/or_check (semantics only, not a PostgreSQL comparison): a lazy CASE form of the same guard, CHECK (CASE WHEN b = 0 THEN 2 ELSE a / b END > 1). The If constructor evaluates only the taken branch, so the verified checker accepts row (5, 0). The review's boolean-valued CASE form is outside the fragment (frontend refusal boolean_value). PostgreSQL was not run on this form.
